x_thread: Zapier, Make or n8n? Pick by who you are, not by feature lists:
Zapier: the widest app coverage and the easiest start. Best if you're not technical.
Make: a visual builder for multi-step flows. Good when flows get complex and you watch costs.
n8n: open source, self-hostable, with AI agent nodes. Best if you're technical and want control.
Start with one workflow that saves you an hour a week. Then decide.
